purpose: Correct cost and execution contracts, then measure finite-capital market ecology without candle-shape targets.
controls: Preserve account population, initial inventory and cash pools relative to the same-seed fast-flow recipe.
Use explicit venue maker fees with 10 ppm minimum quote edge; keep fees unchanged.
Basis entries must leave executable room for both legs' round-trip fees, residual basis, observed closing half-spreads and minimum edge; hedging/exits remain allowed.
All execution parent schedules fit within the declared session; quantities remain capital constrained.
Disable price-attention and activity-excitation in residual ReactiveFlowTrader; do not force a volume/return correlation.

Main profile uses full funded quote depth (base quantity = inventory cap / 16), not the inherited 0.08/0.18 visual depth scales. Earlier prototype runs are retained but excluded from final-code qualification when a risk-exit defect requires a new binary.
Freeze executable, recipes, inputs and seeds before long runs; no parameter selection by candle appearance.
required_checks: Unique trade identities, positive prices/quantities, no self trades, reconciled OHLCV and role totals.
Every newly generated economic maker quote covers its fee and minimum edge at its observed mid.
Internal stops submit market orders; perpetual exits are reduce-only; pending exits persist through partial/no fills and restart.
Separate triggers, generated requests, submitted exits, fills, remaining quantity and confirmed completions.
report_without_cherry_picking: Actual aggressive and passive activity per role; offered parent demand and executed quantities.
Spread, depth, two-sided coverage, rejection reasons and maker PnL versus holding initial inventory.
Return and absolute-return autocorrelations at multiple horizons, order signs, volume, concentration and seed dispersion.
Real paired 10/100-lot buy/sell interventions on seed 7, with no-intervention branches and unchanged parent proof.
limitations: Frozen one-second observation waves and ordered gateway submissions remain. Statistical realism requires a declared real-market reference and longer qualification.
